result.reason: The operative language establishes a mutual aggregate cap equal to the greater of 12 months’ paid or payable fees and USD 1,000,000, includes all required uncapped carve-outs, preserves the mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and excludes properly due fees from the damages cap. The changes are targeted and preserve the clause’s unrelated commercial intent. Minor drafting variances are that the lookback runs from the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself, and the payment clarification refers only to fees rather than all Company payment obligations; these do not prevent the clause from at least satisfying the fallback position.
